title: Downloads: Saving from the Internet
drDigitalIntro:
Downloading brings a file from the internet to your computer.
• Click a download link and the browser saves the file to your Downloads folder.
• The browser's Downloads panel shows your recent files — look for an arrow icon or the word Downloads in the toolbar.
• PDF files can be opened right inside the browser — no extra app needed.
• Avoid downloading files from sites you don't recognize: stick to well-known sources.
• Your Downloads folder can fill up over time — clear it out every few months.

playgroundTask.goal: Download a PDF and open it in the browser viewer

steps.say: Navigate to recipebox.example to find a recipe PDF.
Click the blue Download button to save the recipe PDF.
Click the Downloads panel to see your saved file.
Click Open next to ApplePieRecipe.pdf to read it in the browser.

drDigitalSuccess: You downloaded a PDF and read it without leaving the browser. The file is in Downloads for the next time you want it.
drDigitalHint: Go to recipebox.example, click Download, open the Downloads panel, then click the Open button next to the PDF file.
